definitions.full: H6495. peqach -qoach מְּקַחקֿוֺחַ , read מְּקַחְקוֺחַ noun [masculine] opening (of eyes; compare Comm., Ges § 85n , proposes wide , or complete, opening) ; — לַאֲסוּרִים Isa 61:1 , figurative of freeing from dark prison; but ᵐ5 che Hpt read לְעִוְרִים , compare Di-Kit.
